chunks: And what Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from Yaʿqūb ibn Sālim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:
A man performed tayammum and prayed, then found water while still within the time. He said: His salat has passed, and he should purify himself.

key_terms.الْمَاءَ: water used for normal ritual purification
key_terms.تَيَمَّمَ: performed tayammum as a substitute purification
key_terms.صَلَاتُهُ: his salat that he already performed
key_terms.مَضَتْ: has passed and is considered complete
key_terms.وَقْتٍ: the time period of the prayer
key_terms.وَلْيَتَطَهَّرْ: let him purify himself with proper ritual purification

ai.seo_question: If someone prays with tayammum and then finds water before the prayer time ends, must the salat be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who performed tayammum and then offered salat, but later found water before the prayer time ended. It states that the salat already performed remains valid and does not need to be repeated, though he should then perform purification with water.
